collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLE Class Coupe 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz GLE Class Coupe 2019 Onwards (167) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Mercedes-Benz Specific Fit arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
